Guidance & outlook: The aggregate value of the proposed transactions with ATHPL is expected to be approximately ₹500 Crores (Rupees Five Hundred Crores only) during the Financial Year 2026-27 and is likely to exceed the applicable materiality threshold prescribed under Regulation 23 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
As per the terms of the approved resolution plan, the Company had repaid ₹ 93.27 per Non-Convertible Debenture (NCD) to all Series I Retail NCD holders during FY 2025-26.
The Management of the Company is expecting positive outlook for the Company.
Growth & demand: Further, the transactions are undertaken on mutually agreed terms and are expected to contribute to the overall business objectives and growth of the Company.
Demand for warehousing and logistics facilities remained robust, driven by growth in manufacturing, e-commerce, and supply chain expansion.

The company will:  Launch new phases in existing projects and initiate development on recently acquired land parcels.  Continue strengthening its balance sheet and improve return on equity.  Focus on affordable and mid-income housing, which continues to show resilient demand.  Explore joint ventures and asset-light models to expand operations with reduce…
Margins & costs: The transactions are expected to facilitate operational synergies, efficient utilisation of resources and smooth conduct of business activities.
